description: What side effects do people report for this medicine? Ranks the reactions most often named in reports to the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) for a medicine, with report counts. Popular with patients, journalists and pharmacovigilance work. Source: U.S. FDA openFDA FAERS. Reports are unverified, include every drug the patient was taking, and do not show the medicine caused the reaction or how common it is; label side effect rates are a different measure. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, number of reactions to rank, 1-50, default 10

name.description: string, required, brand or generic name, e.g. metformin

name: fda_drug_side_effects_reported
